extracted.intended_audience: investor relations professionals (NIRI members and prospective members)
extracted.subtask_description: Landing/index page describing NIRI research products (pulse polls, multi-year studies, sponsor reports) used to benchmark IR practices and trends. It catalogs report topics and the metrics/themes each study covers for IR practitioners.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIRI Pulse Polls
rubrics_metrics.description: Concise, timely surveys designed to gather data and report timely results on issues of interest to investor relations professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pulse polls are short, focused instruments intended to surface near-term sentiment and trends. Results are published for members (Pulse poll reports (Members Only)). Use for quick benchmarking and immediate issue awareness rather than deep, longitudinal analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI within IR (NIRI + University of Florida survey)
rubrics_metrics.description: A study/survey to understand the use of AI within investor relations and how IR professionals feel about incorporating these new technologies into daily activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to capture adoption, attitudes, and practical use-cases of AI in IR. Reported as a member-only study (2025 NIRI and University of Florida Research Survey on AI within IR Study Results). Useful for assessing readiness, training needs, and policy implications for AI tools in IR workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: IR Profession and Compensation Metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Research tracking IR profession compensation trends including base salaries, bonus, equity and additional benefits, career trajectory, IR budgets, reporting structure, professional and administrative staff sizes, as well as demographics of the profession and working environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides quantitative benchmarking data for compensation and organizational design. Use these metrics to compare your company's pay and staffing against peers and to inform budgeting, recruiting, and career-path planning (examples: 2024 and 2022 NIRI and Korn Ferry studies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting New Investors — strategic approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Report examining strategies for targeting investors, focusing on advancements in data analytics and personalized communication and how these reshape investor outreach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames effective targeting approaches for modern financial markets; includes recommended methods and insights for applying data analytics and personalization to investor outreach (Targeting New Investors Report 2024). Use to refine outreach segmentation and messaging strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earnings Process Practices — tracked elements
rubrics_metrics.description: Study of trends in earnings announcement processes and IR practices, detailing Quiet Periods, Earnings Guidance, Earnings Releases, Earnings Calls, and Post-Earnings Calls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presents 2023 survey results and trend analysis for benchmarking earnings-disclosure processes. Useful for evaluating your company’s earnings cadence, disclosure policies, and peer practices; helps identify areas for process improvement and governance alignment (Earnings Process Practices Report 2023).

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate Disclosure Trends in Investor Relations (Persefoni-sponsored)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report exploring companies’ responses to investor demand for climate information, including carbon disclosures, management responsibilities, challenges faced, and technology adoption plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides sector insights into how companies report climate data and adopt disclosure technologies; useful for shaping climate disclosure strategy, governance, and tooling decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESG Pulse Report (DFIN-sponsored)
rubrics_metrics.description: Survey assessing a range of ESG topics affecting corporate IRO members professionally, their companies’ current ESG practices and reporting, and their anticipated future state.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A focused snapshot of ESG practices and IRO perspectives; use findings to benchmark company ESG reporting maturity and to inform investor communications and disclosure priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Priorities — Connect.IQ Global 100 (Investis Digital-sponsored)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report surveying IROs and corporate communications professionals on digital priorities for 2021, producing a ‘Global 100’ view of digital initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights digital transformation and communications priorities across companies; use to evaluate website, IR portal, and digital engagement strategies relative to peers.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of Investor Relations in the Virtual World (Cision-sponsored)
rubrics_metrics.description: Survey of senior IR leaders capturing responses to crisis-era virtual operations and views on where the IR industry is headed following significant virtual/remote shifts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides qualitative and quantitative insights into how IR leaders adapted to virtual environments and plans for future hybrid/virtual practices; useful for planning events, roadshows, and virtual investor engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access and Membership Restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: Many NIRI research products are member-only (reports are often labeled 'Members Only').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Researchers and practitioners should note access restrictions when planning to consult NIRI materials; membership provides instant access to the full suite of reports and benchmarking data.
